用手柄的转动控制镜头。关闭后停止体感瞄准；Flick 是否继续工作由它的独立启用: Use controller rotation to aim. Disabling gyro stops motion aim; Flick follows its independent enable setting.
同样的手腕动作，数值越大，镜头转得越多。先校准游戏转角，再用这里调整手感。: Higher values turn the camera farther for the same wrist movement. Calibrate game rotation first, then adjust the feel here.
只调整上下瞄准相对左右瞄准的速度。1 表示相同倍率，小于 1 时上下移动更慢。: Scale vertical aim relative to horizontal aim. 1 uses the same multiplier; smaller values slow vertical movement.
始终开启不需要按键；按住开启只在按住时生效；按一下切换开关则每按一次改变体感开关: Always on requires no button. Hold enables gyro while held. Toggle changes the gyro state with each press.
选择用于开启体感的输入，具体是按住还是按一下切换，由开启方式决定。: Choose the input that enables gyro. The activation mode determines whether to hold or toggle it.
按住时暂停体感瞄准，松开后恢复原来的启用状态。它不会同时关闭 Flick。: Hold to pause gyro aim; release to restore its previous enable state. Flick is not paused by this input.
用扳机或摇杆方向控制体感开关时，需要推到这个幅度才算按下。数值越小，轻推就能触发: When a trigger or stick direction controls gyro, this is the required travel. Lower values activate with a lighter push.
把这个方向的体感输出反过来。只有转动方向与习惯相反时才需要开启。: Reverse gyro output on this axis. Enable it if the current direction feels reversed.
决定怎样理解手柄的转动方向。不同坐标适合不同握法；切换后先试着水平转动和上下抬手: Choose the frame used to interpret controller rotation. Try horizontal turns and tilting after changing it to check the directions.
让左右翻转手柄也参与左右瞄准。绝对值越大，参与越多；负值反转这部分方向，0 表示: Mix controller roll into horizontal aim. Larger magnitudes add more roll; negative values reverse it and 0 disables it.
补偿平时握住手柄时的角度，让转动轴更贴合你的握法。方向已经自然时保持 0。: Compensate for your usual holding angle so the rotation axes match your grip. Leave at 0 if the directions already feel natural.
角速度瞄准看你转动得多快；姿态控制摇杆看你偏离归零姿态多少；体感旋转摇杆用手腕调: Angular-rate aim uses how fast you turn. Pose-to-stick uses displacement from the neutral pose. Gyro stick rotation changes the stick heading with your wrist.
把当前握姿重新作为姿态控制的参考点。适合手腕回到舒服位置后重新开始；不会校准陀螺: Use the current pose as the pose-control reference. Reset after returning to a comfortable grip. This does not calibrate stationary gyro drift.
把当前朝向设为正前方参考。需要让姿态方向重新对齐当前握法时使用。: Set the current heading as the forward reference when you need to realign pose directions with your grip.
从归零姿态转动多少度，输出才达到满杆。数值越小，轻微转动就能得到较大摇杆输出。: Degrees from the neutral pose needed to reach full stick. Smaller values produce more stick output with less rotation.
让姿态控制的参考点逐渐跟随当前握姿，帮助输出回到中心。越大回中越明显，0 关闭自: Let the pose reference follow your grip gradually to help the output return to center. Higher values recenter more strongly; 0 disables it.
按归零键后，用多久过渡到新的参考姿态。较长更柔和，0 立即归零。: Time to transition to the new reference after a reset. Longer values feel smoother; 0 resets immediately.
姿态控制只输出左右方向，不用抬头或低头控制上下轴。: Pose control affects horizontal output only, leaving vertical output unaffected by tilting.
选择要由手腕改变方向的摇杆。它与 Flick 使用同一根摇杆时可能冲突。: Choose the stick whose heading is rotated by your wrist. Using the same stick as Flick can conflict.
同样的手腕转动会让摇杆指向改变多少。数值越大，方向变化越快。: Scale how far the stick heading rotates for a given wrist movement. Higher values change direction faster.
摇杆接近中心时不使用不稳定的方向。调大更容易保持静止，但需要把摇杆推得更远。: Ignore unreliable headings near the stick center. Higher values improve stability but require more travel.
平滑拇指给出的摇杆方向。时间越长越稳，但改变方向时跟随更慢。: Smooth the stick heading supplied by your thumb. Longer times are steadier but respond more slowly.
手腕改变摇杆方向后，允许输出逐渐回到拇指当前指向。回归速度由回归时间设置。: After a wrist adjustment, let output return gradually to the thumb heading. Return time controls the speed.
输出回到拇指方向所用的时间。越短回得越快，越长保留手腕调整的效果越久。: Time to return to the thumb heading. Shorter returns faster; longer retains the wrist adjustment longer.
手腕转动达到设定速度时，让体感接管摇杆方向，减少拇指方向对这段操作的干扰。: Let gyro take over stick heading when wrist movement reaches the threshold, reducing interference from thumb direction.
手腕转动多快才触发接管。数值越低越容易接管，越高越需要明显转动。: Wrist speed required to take over. Lower values activate more easily; higher values require a more deliberate turn.
摇杆推到这个幅度时，把方向交还给拇指。越高越需要贴近外圈才交还。: Stick travel that hands direction back to your thumb. Higher values require pushing closer to the rim.
按住这个输入时，让对应方向沿之前的速度继续运动。松开后恢复普通体感控制。: Hold this input to continue movement on this axis using the previous velocity. Release to return to normal gyro control.
手柄转到舒适范围边缘后，可继续转动镜头。不同方式决定转速来自偏转角度还是出界时的: Continue turning the camera after reaching the edge of your comfortable motion range. The mode chooses angle-based or exit-motion-based speed.
偏离参考姿态多少度后开始边缘转向。越小越早接管，越大越保留自由活动范围。: Angle from the reference pose where edge turning starts. Smaller values engage sooner; larger values leave more free motion.
从普通体感过渡到边缘转向的角度范围。越宽，接管越渐进。: Angular range over which normal gyro blends into edge turning. Wider ranges make the transition more gradual.
进入边缘后，再偏转多少度达到设定的最大持续转速。越小越快达到最大速度。: Additional angular travel at the edge needed to reach maximum sustained speed. Smaller values reach it sooner.
边缘转向允许的最高速度。调高可以持续转得更快，但虚拟摇杆仍受游戏满杆速度限制。: Maximum sustained edge-turn speed. Higher values turn faster, but virtual-stick output remains limited by the game's full-stick speed.
按离开正常范围时的转动速度生成惯性。倍率越大，保留的转向速度越高。: Scale the rotation speed retained when leaving the normal range. Higher multipliers retain more speed.
边缘惯性速度减弱的时间尺度。越长越不容易停，越短越快减速。: Time scale for edge momentum to fade. Longer values coast longer; shorter values slow down sooner.
边缘转向时保留多少普通体感。0 不保留，1 保留完整手腕输入。: How much normal gyro input remains during edge turning. 0 removes it; 1 retains it fully.
边缘转向只负责左右转身，上下瞄准仍由普通体感控制。: Apply edge turning horizontally only; vertical aim stays under normal gyro control.
手腕转速达到这里后开始增加倍率。调高可以让更多慢速动作保持基础灵敏度。: Wrist speed where acceleration begins. Higher values keep more slow movements at base sensitivity.
手腕转速达到这里时使用最高加速倍率。调高意味着需要转得更快才能达到最高倍率。: Wrist speed that reaches the maximum acceleration multiplier. Higher values require faster motion.
决定灵敏度怎样随着手腕速度变化。看曲线可判断慢速微调和快速转身分别会得到多少倍率: Choose how sensitivity changes with wrist speed. The graph shows multipliers for fine aiming and fast turns.
自然曲线在这个手腕速度达到一半的加速增量。调高后，倍率增长得更慢。: Wrist speed where the natural curve reaches half its extra acceleration. Higher values make the increase more gradual.
幂曲线用来衡量快慢的基准速度。与幂指数一起决定加速曲线的形状。: Reference speed for the power curve. Together with the exponent, it determines the acceleration shape.
改变幂曲线的弯曲程度。调整时观察曲线，确认慢速微调和快速转动的倍率符合预期。: Change the power curve's curvature. Watch the graph to check multipliers for slow aiming and fast motion.
S 形加速曲线开始明显变化的中间速度。调高会把主要加速区移向更快的手腕动作。: Middle speed of the S-shaped acceleration transition. Higher values shift the transition toward faster wrist motion.
倍率变化覆盖的速度范围。越宽变化越柔和，越窄越像突然切换倍率。: Speed range over which the multiplier changes. Wider feels smoother; narrower feels more abrupt.
横轴是手腕转速，纵轴是倍率。移动控制点可决定不同速度下的灵敏度；避免让相邻点突然: Horizontal is wrist speed; vertical is the multiplier. Move points to set sensitivity at each speed and avoid abrupt jumps between nearby points.
用不同方法减少体感抖动。自适应滤波会在慢速时更稳、快速变化时更跟手；平滑越强通常: Choose how to reduce gyro jitter. Adaptive filtering steadies slow motion and opens up for rapid changes. Stronger smoothing usually feels less immediate.
转动变快后减少平滑的速度门槛。越低越早恢复直接响应，越高越偏向稳定。: Speed threshold for reducing smoothing as motion gets faster. Lower values restore direct response sooner; higher values favor stability.
自适应滤波在慢速时保留多少细微变化。调低更稳但更黏，调高更跟手但可能更抖。: How much detail adaptive filtering preserves at low speed. Lower is steadier but heavier; higher is more responsive but may jitter.
输入快速变化时，滤波放松得有多明显。调大让快速动作更跟手；0 表示不随变化速度放: How strongly the filter opens up during rapid input changes. Higher values improve fast response; 0 disables this adaptation.
依据静止校准测到的噪声，压制小幅抖动。调大会更稳，也可能吞掉轻微的瞄准动作。: Suppress small movements using the noise measured during stationary calibration. Higher values are steadier but can suppress fine aim.
转速很小时停止输出，帮助镜头停稳。调高更容易停住，但很慢的微调可能不响应。: Stop output at very low speeds to steady the camera. Higher values stop more easily but may ignore very slow aiming.
从低速截止恢复到正常输出的过渡时间。越长越柔和，越短越直接。: Transition time from low-speed cutoff back to normal output. Longer is smoother; shorter is more immediate.
检测到手腕减速时进一步减弱输出，帮助停准。0 关闭；调大刹车更强，也可能让停下前: Reduce output further when your wrist slows to help stop accurately. 0 disables it; stronger braking may make final adjustments feel heavier.
速度下降多少才开始刹车。调低更容易触发，调高只在更明显的减速时触发。: Required drop in speed to engage braking. Lower values trigger more easily; higher values require sharper deceleration.
体感接近水平或垂直方向时，把运动拉向对应轴。角度越大越容易走直线，但斜向微调也更: Pull gyro movement toward horizontal or vertical axes when nearby. Larger angles favor straight lines but can resist diagonal adjustments. This does not snap Flick angles.
逐渐靠近水平或垂直轴，而不是突然吸过去，减轻方向切换的突兀感。: Blend gradually toward the horizontal or vertical axis instead of snapping abruptly.
决定体感计算使用哪一种采样时间。没有明确的时间戳问题时保持当前选择，避免随意改变: Choose the timing source for gyro calculations. Keep the current setting unless you are addressing a known timestamp issue.
按顺序添加额外的体感处理。多个滤波叠加会改变手感；不确定时先使用上面的内置设置。: Add extra gyro processing in sequence. Stacking filters changes the feel; start with built-in settings if unsure.
选择用鼠标还是虚拟右摇杆控制镜头。体感、Flick 和配套瞄准共用此选项；摇杆模: Choose mouse or virtual right-stick camera output. Gyro, Flick and companion aim share this setting. Stick output requires a virtual controller.
忽略中心附近的小幅输入。调大可减少漂移，但需要推得更远才有反应；Flick、摇杆: Ignore small inputs near center. Larger deadzones reduce drift but require more travel. Flick, stick mouse and virtual-stick output share this processing.
抑制松开摇杆时越过中心产生的短暂反向输入。出现松杆后反向晃动时可以开启。: Suppress brief reverse input when the stick springs past center on release. Enable it if releases cause reverse movement.
松杆后识别反向回弹的时间范围。调长能覆盖较慢回弹，但也可能影响快速反向操作。: Time window for detecting reverse rebound after release. Longer values catch slower rebound but may affect deliberate rapid reversals.
八向重叠让斜推同时按下相邻方向，适合 WASD；按轴阈值则分别检查水平和垂直幅度: Eight-way overlap presses neighboring directions together on diagonals, useful for WASD. Axis thresholds evaluate horizontal and vertical travel separately.
填写松手时摇杆的水平偏移，用来修正中心。右为正、左为负；没有偏移时保持 0。: Enter the horizontal reading at rest to correct the center. Right is positive and left negative; use 0 if centered.
填写松手时摇杆的垂直偏移，用来修正中心。上为正、下为负；没有偏移时保持 0。: Enter the vertical reading at rest to correct the center. Up is positive and down negative; use 0 if centered.
按不同方向修正摇杆幅度，补偿推满后各方向不一致的问题。全为 1 表示不修正，建议: Correct stick amplitude by direction to compensate for uneven full travel. All 1s mean no correction; use measured calibration values.
推到这个幅度就算进入外圈，可用于内外圈按键映射。它不是 Flick 的触发距离。: Travel that enters the outer ring for ring-button mappings. This is separate from the Flick trigger distance.
进入外圈后，需要多收回一点才退出，避免在边界反复切换。调大更稳定，但退出要收得更: Require extra inward travel before leaving the outer ring to prevent boundary chatter. Larger values are steadier but require more retraction.
用普通推杆持续移动鼠标。它与 Flick 的定角度转身不同；使用同一摇杆时还受: Move the mouse continuously with stick travel, unlike Flick's angle-based turns. On the same stick, Flick's input suppression also applies.
选择用左摇杆还是右摇杆持续移动鼠标。: Choose the left or right stick for continuous mouse movement.
摇杆推满时的鼠标移动速度。调大移动更快，小幅推杆的速度还取决于响应曲线。: Mouse speed at full stick. Higher values move faster; partial travel also depends on the response curve.
快推摇杆选择转身角度，保持推杆并沿圆周转动可继续旋转镜头。需要先校准游戏转角。: Flick the stick to choose a turn angle, then rotate around the rim to keep turning. Calibrate in-game rotation first.
选择进行 Flick 和配套摇杆瞄准的摇杆。两项功能共用这里的选择。: Choose the stick shared by Flick and companion stick aim.
推到这个幅度才触发初始转身。调低更容易触发，调高更需要推向外圈。: Stick travel required to trigger the initial turn. Lower values trigger more easily; higher values require pushing toward the rim.
完成初始 180° 转角释放所用的时间。按转角调整时间为 0 时，其他角度也用这: Time to release an initial 180° turn. With angle scaling at 0, other angles use the same duration. 0 ms submits the entire angle immediately.
在 Flick 之外增加普通连续瞄准，让推杆幅度控制转速。可结合快速判定区分慢推: Add ordinary continuous aim alongside Flick, with stick travel controlling speed. Speed gating can distinguish slow aiming from quick flicks.
只放大配套连续瞄准的速度，不改变 Flick 的目标角度。: Scale companion continuous aim speed without changing the Flick target angle.
配套摇杆瞄准的基础速度上限，还会受到瞄准倍率影响。它不是游戏实际满杆角速度的校准: Base speed limit for companion stick aim, also scaled by its multiplier. This is not the game's calibrated full-stick angular speed.
调整配套瞄准的上下速度相对左右速度的比例。1 为相同倍率，小于 1 时上下更慢。: Scale vertical companion aim relative to horizontal aim. 1 uses equal multipliers; smaller values slow vertical aim.
减少沿摇杆圆周转动时的方向抖动。调大更稳但跟随更慢；设为 0 关闭这层额外稳定。: Reduce heading jitter while rotating around the stick rim. Higher values are steadier but slower; 0 disables this extra stabilization.
向正前方附近推杆时，不执行初始转身，但仍可继续绕圈。角度越大，正前方不转身的范围: Skip the initial turn when pushing close to forward, while allowing subsequent rotation. Larger angles widen this forward zone.
区分从中心快速推到外圈和慢慢推出。0 关闭速度判定；时间越短，越需要迅速推杆。: Distinguish a quick push to the rim from gradual travel. 0 disables speed gating; shorter windows require a faster push.
启用快速判定后，慢推被认定为瞄准，就不再触发 Flick，直到摇杆回中开始下一次: With speed gating enabled, a slow push stays in aiming mode and cannot trigger Flick until the stick returns to center.
关闭体感总开关后，仍允许 Flick 和配套摇杆瞄准工作，适合只使用摇杆的配置。: Allow Flick and companion aim even when the main gyro switch is off, useful for stick-only profiles.
只在按住这个输入时允许 Flick 和配套瞄准。不设置则无需额外按键，但仍受各自: Allow Flick and companion aim only while this input is held. Leave unset to require no extra button; their enable switches still apply.
决定 Flick 使用摇杆时，普通摇杆映射是否还能收到输入。屏蔽可避免同一动作重: Control whether ordinary mappings also receive the stick used by Flick. Suppression helps avoid driving the camera twice from one movement.
扳机松开时的输入基准，用于修正松手后仍有残余输入。应小于最大原始值。: Raw input at release, used to correct residual travel. It must be below the maximum raw value.
扳机完全拉下时的输入基准，用于把实际行程换算成满行程。应大于最小原始值。: Raw input at full pull, used to scale actual travel to full output. It must exceed the minimum raw value.
把连续行程变成开或关：达到数字阈值时输出满行程。轻拉和全拉动作仍按实际行程区分。: Convert continuous travel to on/off output: reaching the threshold outputs full travel. Soft/full-pull actions still use actual travel.
拉到这个幅度时输出满行程。调低轻拉就触发，调高需要拉得更深。: Travel at which digital output becomes fully pressed. Lower values activate with a light pull; higher values require more travel.
数字扳机触发后，必须多松开一点才释放，减少阈值附近的反复开关。: Require extra release travel after activation to reduce on/off chatter near the threshold.
过滤扳机松开时短暂的输入波动。时间越长越不容易误松开，但真正释放也可能更晚。: Filter brief fluctuations during trigger release. Longer values resist false releases but may delay a real release.
决定拉到底时是否保留轻拉动作，以及快速拉到底能否跳过轻拉。按轻拉和全拉绑定的用途: Choose whether full pull keeps soft-pull actions and whether a quick full pull skips them. Match this to your bindings.
扳机拉到这个幅度才触发轻拉动作。越小越灵敏，越大越需要明显按下。: Travel required to trigger a soft-pull action. Lower values are more sensitive; higher values require a deeper pull.
在这段时间内拉到底才算快速全拉。调长更容易识别为快速操作，某些模式也会等待更久再: Time allowed to reach full pull and count as quick. Longer windows recognize more pulls as quick and can delay soft-pull output in some modes.
让轻拉动作跟随扳机移动的判定，而不是使用上面的固定轻拉幅度阈值。: Use travel-based soft-pull detection instead of the fixed soft-pull threshold above.
用手指在触摸板上滑动来移动鼠标。触摸板四向滑动动作独立设置，关闭鼠标模式不会删除: Move the mouse by sliding on the touchpad. Directional swipe bindings are separate and remain configured when mouse mode is off.
同样的触摸板滑动距离，数值越大，鼠标移动越远。: Higher values move the pointer farther for the same touchpad travel.
调整触摸板滚动的快慢。调大可以用更短的手指移动滚动更多内容。: Adjust touchpad scrolling speed. Higher values scroll farther with less finger movement.
反转触摸板滚动方向，让内容跟随手指移动。按习惯选择即可。: Reverse touchpad scrolling so content follows your fingers. Choose whichever direction feels natural.
软件每秒处理输入的目标频率。调高可能减少等待，但也增加开销；不会让手柄硬件产生更: Target input-processing frequency. Higher rates may reduce waiting but cost more CPU and cannot increase the controller's hardware sample rate.
连续鼠标位移和摇杆轴值的目标发送频率。按键边沿会及时处理；频率更高不一定能改善游: Target send rate for continuous mouse motion and stick axes. Button edges are handled promptly; higher rates do not always improve game response.
选择向系统发送键盘和鼠标输入的方式。所有配置共用，需要停止映射后切换。: Choose how keyboard and mouse input is sent to the system. Shared by all profiles; stop mapping before changing it.
选择创建虚拟 Xbox 或 DS4 手柄的实现。需要对应驱动，所有配置共用。: Choose the implementation that creates virtual Xbox or DS4 controllers. Requires its driver and is shared by all profiles.
静止时陀螺仪的细小波动，用于判断哪些输入可能是噪声。优先使用静止校准测得的结果。: Small gyro fluctuations at rest, used to identify likely noise. Prefer values measured by stationary calibration.
静止时加速度计的波动基准。它是传感器校准数据，不是体感灵敏度。: Baseline accelerometer fluctuations at rest. This is sensor calibration data, not aim sensitivity.
给组合中的其他按键留出同时按下的时间。等待期间单键暂不输出；越长越容易组成组合，: Allow time for other chord buttons to arrive. Single actions wait; longer windows make chords easier but delay singles. 0 disables waiting.
持续按住多久才触发长按。调长更不容易误触发，但需要等待更久。: How long to hold before a long press triggers. Longer values reduce accidental activation but take longer.
第一次操作后，多快再次按下才算双击。调长更容易双击，但同键单次动作可能需要等待更: How soon the next press must arrive to count as a double press. Longer windows make doubles easier but may delay single actions on the same input.
在这段时间内松开才算短按。超过后是否触发其他动作，取决于同一输入的其他映射。: Release within this time to count as a short press. Other mappings determine what happens after a longer hold.
按下时或松开时触发一次输出后，这次输出保持多久。不是开始触发前的延迟。: How long a one-shot press/release output remains active. This is not a delay before triggering.
开启后长按动作一直输出到松手；关闭后只触发一次短脉冲。: Keep a long-press output active until release. When off, emit only a short pulse.
动作生效期间反复按下和松开输出键。连发速度由连发周期决定。: Repeatedly press and release the output while the action is active. The turbo period sets the speed.
一次连发循环的时间。越短连发越快，越长越慢。: Duration of one turbo cycle. Shorter is faster; longer is slower.
把游戏发给虚拟手柄的震动转给实体手柄，需要游戏和当前手柄接口支持。: Forward virtual-controller rumble to the physical controller. Requires support from the game and controller interface.
放大或减弱游戏震动。1 为原强度，0 静音；硬件达到上限后不会继续增强。: Scale game rumble. 1 keeps the original strength and 0 mutes it. Hardware limits still apply.
把游戏发给虚拟手柄的灯光颜色转给实体手柄，需要当前接口支持灯光控制。: Forward game light-bar colors to the physical controller if its interface supports lighting.
软件每秒处理输入的目标频率，单位 Hz。调高可能减少等待，但也增加开销；不会让手: Target input-processing frequency in Hz. Higher rates may reduce waiting but cost more CPU and cannot increase the controller hardware sample rate.
连续鼠标位移和摇杆轴值的目标发送频率，单位 Hz。按键边沿会及时处理；频率更高不: Target rate in Hz for continuous mouse motion and stick axes. Button edges are handled promptly; higher rates do not always improve game response.
同时按住多个手柄输入才触发这条动作。开启后可继续添加输入；组合等待时间决定是否先: Require multiple controller inputs together. Add more inputs after enabling this. Chord wait time determines whether to wait for the remaining inputs.
一次动作同时按下多个输出键，例如 Ctrl+C。它不是按顺序执行的一串动作。: Press multiple output keys together, such as Ctrl+C. This is not a sequence of separate actions.
扳机或摇杆达到这个幅度才算触发。调低更容易触发，调高需要推得更深。: Trigger or stick travel required for activation. Lower values activate more easily; higher values require more travel.
动作保持期间反复滚动。关闭时每次触发只滚动一次。: Repeat scrolling while the action stays active. When off, scroll once per activation.
连续滚动两次之间的等待时间。越短滚得越快，越长越慢。: Delay between repeated scroll steps. Shorter is faster; longer is slower.
用扳机或摇杆启用配置层时，需要达到的幅度。数值越小，轻推就能进入该层。: Travel needed to activate a layer with a trigger or stick. Lower values enter the layer with lighter input.
进入配置层后，需要比触发点多收回一点才退出，避免在阈值附近反复切层。: Require extra inward travel before leaving an active layer to prevent repeated switching near the threshold.
把多大的倾斜角度、转速或加速度视为完整输入，单位随输入类型变化。数值越小，同样动: Tilt, speed or acceleration treated as full input; units depend on the source. Smaller values produce a larger normalized input from the same motion.
经过输入范围和响应曲线处理后，超过这个比例才触发动作。调低更容易触发，调高更需要: Required level after range and response-curve processing. Lower values trigger more easily; higher values require more deliberate motion.
按键触发后要转过的角度。正数向右、负数向左；需要正确校准才能与游戏转角对应。: Angle to turn when the binding fires. Positive turns right and negative left. Correct calibration is needed to match in-game rotation.
这条按键转身动作释放目标转角的时间。0 立即提交；虚拟摇杆实际转完仍受游戏满杆速: Time for this button-turn action to release its target angle. 0 submits it immediately; virtual-stick completion is still limited by game speed.
